result.topic_en: Calculations for the bending and vibration of a thin elastic plate: displacements expressed through the midplane deflection $w_0$, the potential energy (elastic work) of the plate, and the derivation of a frequency constant $\mu^4$ from the variational principle.
result.transcription:
$u = u_0 - \frac{\partial w_0}{\partial x} z$
$v = v_0 - \frac{\partial w_0}{\partial y} z$
$w = [-...-] w_0 + \frac12 z^2 \frac{\theta}{1+\theta}\left(\frac{\partial^2 w_0}{\partial x^2}+\frac{\partial^2 w_0}{\partial y^2}\right)$
$\frac{\partial w}{\partial z}$[?] $\left[2\frac{\partial w}{\partial z} + 2\theta\left(\frac{\partial u}{\partial x}+\frac{\partial v}{\partial y}+\frac{\partial w}{\partial z}\right)\right]\delta w = 0$ $\quad (1+\theta)\frac{\partial w}{\partial z} = +\theta z\left(\frac{\partial^2 w_0}{\partial x^2}+\frac{\partial^2 w_0}{\partial y^2}\right)$
$\frac{\partial u}{\partial x}+\frac{\partial v}{\partial y} = -z\left(\frac{\partial^2 w_0}{\partial x^2}+\frac{\partial^2 w_0}{\partial y^2}\right)$
$-4P = a-b\int \Delta\, dU z^2\left[[-\left(\frac{\partial^2 w}{\partial x^2}+\frac{\partial^2 w}{\partial y^2}\right)^2-] 4\left(\frac{\partial^2 w}{\partial x\partial y}\right)^2 + 2\left(\frac{\partial^2 w}{\partial x^2}\right)^2 + 2\left(\frac{\partial^2 w}{\partial y^2}\right)^2 [-+2\frac{1+\theta}{\theta}\left(\frac{\partial w}{\partial z}\right)^2-]\right.$
$+$ $\qquad + 2\frac{\theta}{1+\theta}\left(\frac{\partial^2 w}{\partial x^2}+\frac{\partial^2 w}{\partial y^2}\right)^2$
$-\frac{\partial\left(\frac{\partial^2 w}{\partial x^2}+\frac{\partial^2 w_0}{\partial y^2}\right)}{\partial y} z + \frac{1+2\theta}{1+\theta}\frac{\partial\left(\frac{\partial^2 w}{\partial x^2}+\frac{\partial^2 w}{\partial y^2}\right)}{\partial y} z$
$+\frac{\theta}{1+\theta}\frac{\partial\left(\frac{\partial^2 w}{\partial x^2}+\frac{\partial^2 w}{\partial y^2}\right)}{\partial y} z\,\delta v$
$\left(\frac{\partial^2 w}{\partial x^2}+\frac{\partial^2 w}{\partial y^2}\right)\left[\left(1-\frac{\theta}{1+\theta}\right) + \frac{(1+2\theta)^2}{1+\theta}\right]\delta w$
$\frac{(1+2\theta)^2}{1+\theta}$
$-1\frac{\partial\left(\frac{\partial^2 w}{\partial x^2}+\frac{\partial^2 w}{\partial y^2}\right)}{\partial y} z - \frac{(1+2\theta)^2}{1+\theta}$
$[-z-]\ \frac{\partial\left(\frac{\partial^2 w}{\partial x^2}+\frac{\partial^2 w}{\partial y^2}\right)}{\partial y}\left(1+\frac{1+2\theta}{1+\theta}\right) z$
$\left(\frac{\theta}{1+\theta}+1\right) + \frac12 z^2\frac{\theta}{1+\theta}\Delta^2 w_0 - \frac{1+2\theta}{1+\theta}$
$-4P = \frac{(a-b)\frac{1+2\theta}{1+\theta}}{}$[?] $\int\Delta\, dU$

$\delta P = \int [-...-] \Delta\, dU \frac{\partial^2 w}{\partial t^2}\delta w$
$[-\frac{\partial^2 w}{\partial t^2}-]\int \Delta\, dU\, a^2 [-...-] w^2$
$(a-b)\frac{\varepsilon^3}{3.4}\Delta\delta\int dx\,dy\,[\ ]$
$= -4\delta P = 2\Delta\varepsilon a^2\delta\int dx\,dy\, w^2$
$(a-b)\frac{\varepsilon^2(1+2\theta)}{12\, a^2(1+\theta)} = \frac{1}{\mu^4}$
$\delta P = \int\Delta\, dU\frac{\partial^2 w}{\partial t^2}\delta w$
$-4P = 2a^2\int\Delta\, dU\, w^2$
